name: Firecrawl
cost: Open source (mostly AGPL-3.0, SDKs MIT). Firecrawl Cloud gives 1,000 free credits a month with no API key or signup; paid pricing is not stated in the README.
works_with: Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Gemini CLI, Codex and any MCP client
short: Lets your AI agent search, scrape and crawl the web as clean markdown, locally or through Firecrawl's cloud.
what: Firecrawl turns websites into markdown your AI can use. Firecrawl Local is one binary that scrapes, crawls and maps sites on your machine, serves the Firecrawl API on localhost and plugs into your agent as an MCP server. Firecrawl Cloud adds search, structured JSON, page interaction, an agent and 550+ data providers through Alexandria.
who: Developers building agents or apps that need web content. If you only want to read one page now and then, your agent's built-in browsing may be enough.
needs: For Firecrawl Local: Rust and a C compiler (`xcode-select --install` on macOS, `build-essential` on Debian or Ubuntu)
Node.js 22 or newer for the MCP server
Optional: Chrome or Chromium for pages that need JavaScript
Optional: a Firecrawl API key for the cloud features

steps.title: Add it to your AI agent
steps.text: Finds supported agents on your machine and adds Firecrawl Local as an MCP server. Restart the agent afterwards.

steps.title: No Rust? Try the cloud CLI
steps.text: Runs the same scrape with nothing to build and no signup.

try.label: From the README
try.text: Crawl a docs site into one markdown file per page: `firecrawl-local crawl https://docs.firecrawl.dev --limit 50 --out ./pages`.

watch: By default, a single-page scrape that won't load locally is sent to Firecrawl Cloud instead. Set `FIRECRAWL_CLOUD=off` to keep everything on your machine.
`init` edits your AI tools' config files. It backs each one up first.
The README says you are responsible for respecting each website's policies when scraping. Firecrawl respects robots.txt by default.
Self-hosting the full server needs Docker Compose, Redis, PostgreSQL and a browser service.
